answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require every identity to stake a small refundable bond in a shared kernel contract and publish a periodic heartbeat signed by its own key. A rotating beacon, chosen unpredictably from staked identities, issues attestation challenges; agents that answer honestly build reputation through a prism of independent peer checks, while identities that duplicate work or fail challenges forfeit their bond and are pruned. Forging thousands of fake agents then costs real stake per identity, making mass fakery unprofitable.
